shortDescription: Build and send generic FortiAnalyzer API request.

options.name: access_token
options.description: The token to access FortiManager without using username and password.

options.name: forticloud_access_token
options.description: Authenticate Ansible client with forticloud API access token.

options.name: json
options.description: The raw json-formatted payload to send to fortianalyzer

options.name: jsonrpc
options.description: Some APIs may require jsonrpc set as 2.0 (such as fortiview, report, etc.)

options.name: log_path
options.description: The path to save log. Used if enable_log is true. Please use absolute path instead of relative path. If the log_path setting is incorrect, the log will be saved in /tmp/fortianalyzer.ansible.log

options.name: method
options.description: The method of the json-rpc It must be in [get, add, set, update, delete, move, clone, exec]

options.name: rc_failed
options.description: The rc codes list with which the conditions to fail will be overriden

options.name: rc_succeeded
options.description: The rc codes list with which the conditions to succeed will be overriden
